shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a stone surface
suggestion of an anthropomorphic form (schematic body/head in A, human figures in B)
circular/disc-like shapes (concentric disc on A, bowls held in B)
horizontal banded elements crossing the surface
justification: The only correspondences are generic: both surfaces carry shallow relief carving, both involve some anthropomorphic reference and both include roundish disc-like shapes (a concentric circle on A, held bowls on B). B depicts a specific repeated processional scheme of profile human figures with elaborately curled hair and beards, one behind another, each carrying an offering vessel, while A shows a single frontal, massively schematic block-like figure covered with abstract curvilinear and geometric motifs and horizontal bands, with no procession, no profile heads and no held objects.
